fact: ANIP's director general says the single-window birth declaration and registration is in a pilot in ten health facilities, with health agents now using new internet-connected terminals for declarations and registration feeding the national register of natural persons (RNPP), with generalisation to all facilities planned.

La Nation (2026-07-16) reports that since August 2025 the Guichet unique d'enregistrement des naissances, run by ANIP with Wuri and UNICEF, registers births digitally in ten pilot public health facilities, with parents leaving with the birth certificate.
ANIP says secure birth certificates are now issued from data in the RNPP and the national civil-status file, per a note signed 5 May 2026.
Law 2020-34 of 6 January 2021 dematerialised civil status and abolished paper civil registers, so every birth is registered in the RNPP, which counts as the civil-status declaration, per ANIP.
